name: GAN 356 M
features: Chỉnh được lực nam châm và độ căng
reviews: Lựa chọn phổ biến khi lên đời cube nam châm
description: The GAN 356 M is a modern, mid-range magnetic 3x3 speed cube by popular manufacturer GAN. This version comes with GAN’s unique hand adjustable Numerical IPG Core and a set of spare GES nuts. Out of the box, the GAN 356 M has a fast, stable feel that is very reminiscent of a mix between the GAN XS and GAN X V2, two of GAN's most famous flagships.
